name: babyshalls-monorepo
description: BabyShalls E-Commerce Platform (Next.js 16 + Express API + Prisma + Redis)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
